name: omp-dev-team
description: Oh-My-Pi marketplace: dev-team (persona dev team) and azure-devops-fs (Azure DevOps as a filesystem). Two independent plugins.
comment: This repo is an OMP MARKETPLACE. Catalog: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; plugins live under plugins/<name>/, each with its own package.json (omp.extensions) and .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Add it with `omp plugin marketplace add <repo-or-./>` then install plugins individually. The two plugins are independent.
